newsitem.title: UK: UK's Charter commercial director to leave.
newsitem.headline: UK's Charter commercial director to leave.

text.p: Industrial group Charter plc said on Monday its commercial director, Charles Parker, would leave the company on December 31.
Finance director Nigel Robson will assume responsibility for business development.
"Current operating performance continues to be in-line with our expectations, in spite of the impact of the recent appreciation of sterling," the company said in a statement.
The company also said it named Per Svantesson as managing director of Esab Europe, with effect from December 2.
Per was previously president and managing director of the Automotive Division of Valeo SA in North America, the company said.
